answer: A Design mockup passing automated tests backed by a refundable deposit makes identity cost real work: the design mockup is reviewed line by line, the refundable deposit is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so a Sybil farm must produce genuine, reviewed output for every fake account it wants. Reviewers look for the ember that does not belong: work with no substance behind it. A copper alone is noise; a bridge of accepted work is a pattern the network can trust.
